notation: Each line describes an operation, independent of frontend syntax. An input and a newly allocated turn buffer may alias after assignment. A copied numeric observation has value semantics. End of event and await expire references to turn storage.

cases.name: borrow helper
operations: helper(p) reads first code unit and returns scalar

cases.name: escaping helper
operations: helper(p) stores argument in persistent state

cases.name: dead alternate arm
operations: if flag: p = turn buffer; consume p; return
